collection.cache_note: History includes cached statuses; leaderboard uses BuildBuddy cached=0 classification and omits targets without likely flakes. Sharded cache classification is not an independent-execution denominator.

prior_report.disposition: Prior performance and cancellation measurements retained as historical context; current study specializes in failures.

static_patterns.mechanism: Spin test sleeps 500ms, then only checks page errors. A slow response can bypass the path it intends to test.
static_patterns.change_and_validation: Wait for Spinning… after response mapping, then check errors. Validate with a response delayed past 500ms and an intentionally broken mapping.

static_patterns.mechanism: Debounce tests sleep 200/250ms around 50/100ms timers, then assert reconciliation. Event-loop load changes whether it has run.
static_patterns.change_and_validation: Use a controlled timer plus an event at reconcile entry; assert coalescing/order and shutdown behavior.

static_patterns.mechanism: A 100ms delay is used as proof that a different D-Bus connection dispatched a signal; the negative case can miss a late callback.
static_patterns.change_and_validation: Await a callback event/queue; use an explicit dispatch barrier for the unsubscribe assertion.

static_patterns.mechanism: Later tests depend on a document/object created by an earlier test in the module-scoped FreeCAD process.
static_patterns.change_and_validation: Put the two-call persistence behavior in one test and independently create other test state. Validate isolated selection and reversed order.

static_patterns.mechanism: pick_free_port closes its probe socket before a child binds. Another process can claim the port.
static_patterns.change_and_validation: Pass a reserved socket or use port 0 with discovery. If unavailable, retry only a confirmed EADDRINUSE. Force the collision in validation.

static_patterns.mechanism: Fixed localhost:9875 can reach another listener; XML-RPC ping has no request timeout, so the outer readiness deadline cannot bound a stuck call.
static_patterns.change_and_validation: Use a unique endpoint and finite socket timeout; verify server identity. Validate against an accepting-but-silent listener.

run_query.pagination: all pages fetched per workflow per 24h slice
run_query.date_filter: created=start..end (API inclusive); records locally filtered to [start,end), and deduplicated by workflow run ID

artifacts.raw_daily_slices: ci_d1.json through ci_d7.json; trusted_d1.json through trusted_d7.json

pr_job_results.denominator_rule: Bazel CI job conclusion among completed PR test-job runs. Exclude skipped (workflow/job not applicable) and cancelled (incomplete/superseded). For successful workflows, Bazel job success is inferred from the checked workflow DAG; every terminally failed PR workflow has direct job-list attribution.

ci.yml.failure_attribution: All 173 terminally failed ci.yml PR workflows had bazel-ci / Test & Build fail. ci.yml has no release or push-images job active for pull_request events.

trusted-fork-pr-ci.yml.failure_attribution: For 329 terminally failed PR workflows, 285 had a direct Bazel job failure, 2 had a successful Bazel job but another job failed, and 42 had the Bazel job skipped. Of the 44 with no Bazel failure, the named job groups overlap within runs.

combined.interpretation: Bazel CI job failures include both BUILD_FAILURE and TESTS_FAILED; this is not a pure assertion-only test failure rate.

reruns.interpretation: Reruns are selected by people or workflow behavior; 21/30 is an observed recovery count, not an estimate of the population flake probability. The 21 recovered pairs were all tested at the exact same commit SHA.

limitations_and_caveats: The rerun cohort is a selected subset; the 21/30 recovery count is descriptive, not a population flake probability.
Bazel job failures include build errors and test failures. Of the 21 same-SHA recovered transitions, invocation metadata classified 17 first failures as TESTS_FAILED and 4 as BUILD_FAILURE.

All terminally failed PR workflows had job lists queried. Successful workflow job statuses were inferred from the checked workflow DAG rather than querying every passing run. Canceled workflow job statuses were not collected and cancellations are excluded from the pass/failure denominator.

Only 20 failed rerun Bazel job logs were retrieved (10 per workflow), date-spread with both failed attempts from two persistent CI runs included. Log examples are non-exclusive and are not a representative sample of every failure.

A bb view --errors query against default remote.buildbuddy.io first failed DNS. An attempt to reroute that bb command to app.buildbuddy.io was rejected by auto-review, whose stated reason was: “The repository instructions say to stop and report BuildBuddy connectivity failures rather than retrying through an alternate endpoint after remote.buildbuddy.io is unreachable.” The parent later verified default-host DNS/TLS recovery and is retrieving remaining BuildBuddy views. This report relies on GitHub job logs and already-collected invocation metadata for signatures/source comparison.
